headline: Wearable ultrasound patch boosts REM sleep without drugs or surgery

items.title: Wearable ultrasound patch boosts REM sleep without drugs or surgery
items.summary: A new wearable patch may help people reach REM sleep faster and remain there longer without medication or surgery. Researchers also observed signs of improved stress regulation and changes in brain circuits tied to emotion.
